title: Features page lists factions, quests, XP, sell & split and more
summary: The Features page had fallen behind the app. It now lists twenty more features, and each entry links to the Help topic that explains it.
items: New entries: fairness ledger, sell & split, unidentified items, ledger CSV export, XP and milestones, attunement, charges and uses, and 3D dice.
Also new: merchant purses, market events, settlement sizes, Why this price?, shop lists, factions and Favor, the favor market and quests.
And: split the party, session recaps, preview as player and the What players can see page.
How it works on an entry opens its topic in the Help guide.
The player Help guide shows Lootsplit is now Lootsplitter once instead of twice.
